snippet.title: Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny - Official Reveal
snippet.description:
The dice have been cast! Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny coming Fall ‘25! 

Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny is a vibrant, universe-spanning mashup that brings iconic Nickelodeon heroes into a world of fantasy-style tropes and real-time RPG action. 

Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny will be available on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X | S, Nintendo Switch, Steam, and Epic Games Store. To wishlist on your favorite platforms, visit our game page at https://gamemill.com/games/nicktoonsdiceofdestiny.

Follow us for more news and character reveals: 
X https://twitter.com/NickRPGGame
Instagram https://instagram.com/NickRPGGame
Discord https://discord.gg/BddcmTJk25
